messages:
Eve: Quick thread: we need a fresh pass on the multi-mode landing pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Focus: crystal-clear hero lines, one compact benchmark per page, and clean inbound routing to Sales/Support/SDR. Thoughts?
Sam: I can take hero variants. My instinct: avoid jargon in hero. Options: "Low-latency LLM inference you can count on" vs "Run production LLMs with predictable cost and SLAs". Keep subhead to explain mode differences in one sentence.
Rohit: For Dedicated, highlight throughput + reserved capacity. Single stat: "up to X tokens/sec" (rounded). For Hosted: p95 latency stat. Private: compliance bullet only (KMS, audit logs).
Clara: Routing proposal: form writes mode_interest + company_size_bucket + compliance_needs. Automation rules: if company_size_bucket == "enterprise" OR compliance_needs == "yes" -> route to sales-solutions; else -> growth-sdr. Also add webinar_opt_in tag if they click benchmarking CTA.
Eve: Love it. Can we make the hero micro-survey optional? Mobile-friendly toggle that surfaces UX for each mode. Keep it subtle.
docs-bot: New doc created: /drive/marketing/landing-copy/variant-summary.md
Sam: I'll create 3 hero mockups: plain headline, headline+stat, headline+mini-toggle. Will post links.
Rohit: HubSpot pseudo-rule I propose:
```
if form.company_size_bucket == "enterprise" or form.compliance_needs == "yes":
  owner = "solutions_sales"
elif form.company_size_bucket == "midmarket":
  owner = "ae_growth"
else:
  owner = "sdr_selfserve"
# set tag: mode_interest = form.mode_interest
# if form.webinar_cta == true -> add to benchmarks_workflow
```
Clara: Also suggest a hidden field for headline_variant so we can attribute conversions back to specific copy.
Eve: Good call. Action owners: Sam = mockups + upload, Rohit = automation rules + sample JSON, Clara = form fields + tracking, In = review and finalize microcopy. Review in 24 hours.
Sam: Uploaded mockups to drive: /drive/marketing/landing-copy/mocks/2387654321.
Rohit: I'll push automation draft by EOD.
Clara: I'll add the headline_variant hidden field and ensure UTMs are appended.
Eve: Final ask: webinar landing copy should be neutral, include methodology note and a short FAQ about what the benchmarks measure. Keep form to 4 fields. We'll A/B headline vs stat placement over two weeks.
